workflow_runs.name: Codex review request
workflow_runs.display_title: ci: stop caching Android build trees and verify the Skia wasm slice on every run

head_commit.message:
ci: stop caching Android build trees and verify the Skia wasm slice on every run

The Actions cache was at 9.997 GB of its 10 GB cap. Two entries that
never restored held 6.5 GB of it:
- android.yml cached android/app/.cxx, the native build tree, under a
  key that changed on almost every main push. 0 of 10 sampled jobs
  restored it, and each one saved another 3 GB (40-140 s of post-step).
- cross-platform-check put the same tree into its 3.5 GB Gradle entry,
  which was evicted before every nightly run (0 of 7).
Together they pushed out the Windows build ccache and FetchContent
entries that build.yml restores on PRs.

Both workflows now cache only ~/.gradle downloads, restore on
GitHub-hosted runners, and save only on main. The Windows save failed
its tar step on every run because the Gradle daemon held cache locks,
so the daemon is stopped before saving.

The Skia wasm slice was cached as its unpacked tree. A cache hit
skipped the sha256 check, and a runner that kept $HOME reused
~/skia-wasm across pin bumps. The archive is now cached, named and keyed
by the pinned sha256. It is checked against the digest on every run and
unpacked into the job's temp dir. Only wclap-cloudflare's main push
saves it. The self-hosted GPU audio job keeps the verified archive on
local disk instead of using actions/cache.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
